title: NIST WebBook: Octane is C8H18, molecular weight 114.2285 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Octane as C8H18, molecular weight 114.2285 amu, CAS 111-65-9.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Octane, CAS Registry Number 111-65-9, lists molecular formula C8H18 and molecular weight 114.2285 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 114.1408506 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/C8H18/c1-3-5-7-8-6-4-2/h3-8H2,1-2H3. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
